tools.name: architecture_atlas
tools.description: Query the canonical architecture atlas (lossless registry; simplified views are generated). ops: summary | expand(view) | get(id) | cannot_infer(id) | search(query) | loss. Consult before architecture work instead of re-deriving from memory.

tools.name: bonfyre_moe_generate
tools.description: Generate through the persistent local Qwen MoE Metal service and return a hashed receipt.

prompt.description: User request for local MoE generation

tools.name: bonfyre_moe_status
tools.description: Return the managed local MoE service health and loaded model metadata.

tools.name: bonfyre_quic_fpq_generate
tools.description: Generate through the managed Qwen FPQ runtime over the resident ngtcp2 QUIC service, then record the completion in CMS/LambdaTensor, Graph, Flow, and DisCIPL.

prompt.description: User request for QUIC-backed FPQ generation

tools.name: capability_fulfillment
tools.description: Open, inspect, or record payment presentation for one native Capability Fulfillment ProtocolMachine shared by x402, MPP, MCP, A2A, CloudEvents, Beckn, UCP, and ACP. It uses the operating book and durable lifecycle owner; it never pretends a quote or payment claim is verified settlement, execution, or delivery.

exchange.description: Stable idempotency identity for this buyer/capability exchange

payment_reference.description: Opaque presented payment reference; retained only as a SHA-256 receipt reference

tools.name: cms_record
tools.description: Use the real native BonfyreCMS owner to list schemas or list/get/create/update records in a namespace. Use frappe_compile with cms_doctype first when a compiled Frappe DocType needs a safe CMS record projection. This never executes Frappe controllers, publishes content, settles money, or acts against a foreign system.

content_type.description: Required except list_types; native CMS content type identifier

attributes.description: Required for create/update; values are validated by the native CMS schema

tools.name: cms_read
tools.description: Read the native BonfyreCMS owner without exposing create/update actions. Lists schemas or lists/gets records in one namespace. This is a read projection only: it does not publish, mutate CMS, invoke Frappe, or grant external authority.

content_type.description: Required except list_types; native CMS content type identifier

tools.name: training_public_programs
tools.description: Read current, explicitly MCP-enabled public training programmes from their native BonfyreCMS release owner. Content is digest-verified and excludes private member requests, publisher identity, training history, payment and coaching consent.

studio.description: Explicitly enabled public fitness creator studio

tools.name: commercial_state
tools.description: Read the estate's commercial position across the stores that own it, joined on the finance opportunity id: 'relationships' gives one line per opportunity with what was sent, what came back, its CRM deal, its commerce stage, its price and open requirements, and what is missing; 'books' gives the journal totals derived from recorded invoices, payments and costs beside the quotations, pledges and expected costs that are not on the books; 'exchange' gives one exchange's stage in the fifteen-stage commerce chain. Read-only. It sends nothing, prices nothing and settles nothing.

exchange.description: For view=exchange: the exchange id, e.g. opportunity:<finance opportunity id>

tools.name: estate_recall
tools.description: Find passages in a store the estate built over its own records and documents, by meaning and by their own words together (local reciprocal-rank fusion; each hit says where it ranked in each). The default store, campaign, holds the operator's working thread read from its page, every outbound_message coordination record, the no-simulation ledger, the convergence plan and the library productization plan; each hit comes back with its text and an id naming its source (thread:<n>, outbound_message:<record id>, measured:<n>, work:<n>, convergence:<n>, libraries:<n>). Use it before re-reading those sources. Read-only; the store is rebuilt with 'bonfyre recall index-sources'.

text.description: What to look for, in plain words

collapse_exact_text.description: Optional presentation-only grouping of byte-identical source passages. Keeps every distinct source ID.

store.description: Store name under the estate's recall directory

tools.name: financial_membrane
tools.description: Use the real native BonfyreEconomy membrane: inspect actual caps and observed costs, set a cap, route a recipe, or record an explicitly observed cost. It does not create cash, an invoice, a settlement, or spend authority.

tools.name: financial_read
tools.description: Read the native BonfyreEconomy membrane without exposing cap or cost mutations. Status reads operating caps/cost observations/service book; route returns a recommendation and estimate only. Neither action spends, settles, books cash, or commits a provider.

recipe.description: Required for route; stable recipe identifier

tools.name: foreign_twin_observe
tools.description: Observe one public HTTP(S) source through the native BonfyreProject ForeignTwin owner. It performs robots preflight, retains exact permitted bytes with a receipt, and returns an observe-only boundary. It never claims, connects, canonicalizes, or acts against the source.

twin_id.description: Stable safe identifier for this observation subject

tools.name: foreign_twin_release
tools.description: Read the actual bounded WebAddress ForeignTwin release, or resolve a multi-source case from exact published source URLs. Optional context queries return unrelated discovery candidates only. Returns generation-pinned source_refs and SHA-256 readback receipts; never observes, publishes, or joins authority.

tools.name: frappe_compile
tools.description: Compile one installed Frappe lineage through phase 0-12 into retained native AppPack, SchemaIR, binding derivations and rule universes. This extracts grammar only: it never executes a Frappe controller, hook, migration, site, or external effect.

cms_doctype.description: Optional installed DocType to compile and register as a safe native CMS schema; requires phase 1+

tools.name: institutional_prepare
tools.description: Run a real non-effecting institutional preparation: native recipe compilation + economic route + local MoE or QUIC/FPQ generation, then persist the generation receipt through CMS/LambdaTensor, Merkle Graph, Flow, and DisCIPL. It always refuses outreach, payment, publication, legal submission, and foreign mutation because those need separate authority.

subject.description: Stable Matrix subject or safe local identifier

tools.name: matrix_address_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a host/path/world/audience/representation through the configured native BonfyreWebAddress/Matrix owner. Use before treating a URL as a Matrix coordinate. It returns an address cut plus explicit unresolved authority, evidence, provider and economic closures; it never bootstraps demo state or grants read/effect authority.

tools.name: matrix_closure_compile
tools.description: Compile one exact native Matrix host/path cut into a sparse RO-Crate JSON-LD or Zarr v3 group. This is the shared system closure carrier for web/CMS/Frappe/MCP/agent work: Matrix identity, address and Presence resolve once; other planes are either explicitly unresolved or show only digest-and-receipt owner references. A reference never grants a body read, authority, provider route, Work, or financial claim.

path.description: Exact local Matrix path on that controlled host, e.g. /plants/luna

tools.name: matrix_subject_constellation
tools.description: Read the lawful web/API/MCP/A2A/other coordinates already bound around one Matrix subject from the configured native owner. Use after a subject is known. Coordinates are not copies and never authorize disclosure or effects.

tools.name: native_tool_inventory
tools.description: Find native owners by family, capability or synopsis. Set surface=commands to read the exact public bonfyre CLI catalog from its native owner (all=true includes labs). Owner discovery does not prove runtime readiness or effect authority.

surface.description: owners (default) or the canonical CLI command catalog

all.description: With surface=commands, include lab and internal commands

limit.description: Defaults to 20 when any filter or display option is supplied.

tools.name: native_tool_invoke
tools.description: Invoke one audited read-only command of a compiled Bonfyre native owner. Generic argv rejects all other verbs, extra arguments and mutation routes. Use destination-owned MCP/HTTP tools for effects; those require current ActorClosure, PackGraph and independent reviewed WorkGraph admission.

tools.name: estate_capabilities
tools.description: Read the coalesced local estate control plane: native tools, discovered models, generation profiles, live adapters and reconciled provider fleet. Short-lived caches collapse repeated filesystem and PATH discovery; refresh bypasses them. This is discovery and health state, not provider authority.

tools.name: estate_adapter_probe
tools.description: Run bounded local health probes for installed estate adapters and retain the probe receipts. Commands and argv come only from the fixed adapter catalogue; this does not authenticate a provider, spend, publish, or mutate a foreign system.

tools.name: mcp_runtime_identity
tools.description: Report the running Project MCP release identity: active capability pack, launched source-set digest, current declared source-set digest, advertised tool count, and current/drifted/unattested/source_unavailable state. This detects source/runtime drift without claiming transitive dependency or deployment authority.

tools.name: mcp_capability_lens
tools.description: Search the canonical MCP tool catalogue by intent, owner and read/effect class without loading the full tool wall. Summary mode returns compact routing metadata; full mode returns schemas only for the selected shortlist. This is catalogue discovery, not service-health or effect authority.

tools.name: mcp_read_bundle
tools.description: Run up to eight already-authorized read-only MCP tools concurrently inside one authenticated Project request. Every child is checked against its canonical schema and the active capability aperture before dispatch. Results remain independent owner reads, not an atomic snapshot and never an effect shortcut.

tools.name: mcp_pack_snapshot
tools.description: Read one canonical capability pack as a server-owned operational snapshot. The pack definition selects only context-free read-only entry probes; each child still crosses its own owner boundary and is validated through the same read-bundle contract. Packs that require account or address context return an empty snapshot plus their handoff plan rather than inventing context.

tools.name: mcp_product_plan
tools.description: Compose one capability pack into a single read-only product plan: runtime/source identity, operational snapshot, compact capability shortlist, handoffs and next effect names. pack=auto deterministically ranks declared pack routing terms from intent; narrowed endpoints remain confined to their active pack. It replaces separate pack-snapshot and capability-lens client calls without changing their owner or authority boundaries.

tools.name: mcp_portfolio_plan
tools.description: Compose a multi-pack Aurekai objective into one compact read-only portfolio. Auto mode selects the strongest matching capability packs; explicit packs preserve caller order. Pack plans run concurrently, exact overlapping owner reads coalesce only while in flight, and the response returns compact readiness, handoffs and next effects rather than duplicating full snapshot bodies. This is routing and readiness, never effect authority.

tools.name: operator_backlog_audit
tools.description: Audit one operator goal-state cohort without mutation. Returns bounded exact goal rows with run counts, source counts, repeated exact-title review cohorts, and the exact returned queued goal IDs that are eligible for zero-history supersession. Cohorts are hints for review, never semantic deduplication claims.

tools.name: operator_goal_supersede
tools.description: Retire an exact reviewed batch of never-started queued non-recurring goals from scheduling while retaining their database rows and history. Requires the operator STOP switch to remain active. Any unknown id, non-queued state, recurring goal or prior run refuses the entire transaction.

tools.name: operator_goal_add
tools.description: Add or reprioritize a persistent autonomous operator goal.

tools.name: operator_pause
tools.description: Activate the local autonomous operator kill switch.

tools.name: operator_resume
tools.description: Remove the autonomous operator kill switch and resume queued work.

tools.name: operator_maturation_ledger
tools.description: Read the exact ~/.bonfyre/backlog/items.tsv in bounded pages; inventory Atlas and handoff candidates; seed all unverified source-backed candidates; or atomically record up to 100 evidence-backed verdicts on existing rows. Writes require current file SHA-256, MCP write gate and operator STOP; each DONE verifies exact current source SHA and nonempty independent test witnesses. No new scope, no automatic completion, no operator resume.

tools.name: operator_status
tools.description: Return autonomous operator mode, pause state, queued goals, recent runs, and failures.

tools.name: project_apply_low_risk_patch
tools.description: Autonomously apply a bounded patch only when path, size, clean-file, and local policy gates all pass.

tools.name: project_apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a manually approved patch using the local approval token.

tools.name: project_commit_receipt
tools.description: Commit only files from a verified operator patch receipt when auto-commit policy is enabled.

tools.name: project_diff
tools.description: Return status plus working or staged git diff.

tools.name: project_patch_preview
tools.description: Before implementing, pass paths (up to 16) to inspect current preimage hashes, dirty state and configured write constraints without preparing a patch or writing receipts. Then pass patch for Git validation and low-risk eligibility. Use exactly one of paths or patch. Preflight grants no write authority.

tools.name: project_read
tools.description: Read one source range or up to 16 file ranges in one call, with exact whole-file SHA-256 and continuation lines. Use files for related owners/tests. if_sha256 returns only identity when unchanged. Shared batch limits: 32 MiB source, 512 KiB response. File reads are individually checked, not an atomic checkout snapshot.

if_sha256.description: Previously observed whole-file digest. Matching bytes omit content; this does not attest prior range coverage.
Previously observed whole-file digest. Matching bytes omit content; this does not attest prior range coverage.

files.description: Use instead of top-level path and range options.

tools.name: organ_drift_status
tools.description: Compare checkout-built native organs with the managed ~/.bonfyre/bin realizations using content digests. Optional verify fails closed on drift. Read-only: it never promotes or installs bytes.

tools.name: organ_drift_sync
tools.description: Atomically promote one exact existing managed native organ to the digest-verified checkout build, or explicitly install it when install_missing=true. Requires the Project write gate, serializes with operator effects, refuses while STOP is active, and verifies the target after promotion.

tools.name: project_retire_sources
tools.description: Retire a reviewed group of authored non-test scripts only after matching the exact SHA-256 of every source and a native C replacement, passing the replacement's Makefile test before and after, and creating a restore-verified compressed archive. A failed post-test restores absent sources. Never relax the ratchet or activate a public release.

tools.name: project_revert_receipt
tools.description: Revert a patch previously applied by the operator using its receipt ID.

tools.name: project_search
tools.description: Ripgrep live source with line and column locations.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Current branch, HEAD, dirty files, staged files, and project root.

tools.name: project_test_profile
tools.description: Run an allowlisted project verification profile.

tools.name: project_tree
tools.description: Bounded project tree listing.

ref.description: Opt into a read-only pinned Git subtree projection: HEAD or an exact 40/64-hex commit. This mode returns regular tracked blob identities, not live files; depth must be omitted.

resources.name: Bonfyre Architecture Atlas
resources.description: Canonical architecture summary. Read before proposing an architecture change.

resources.name: Native capability estate
resources.description: Currently callable managed/native Bonfyre command owners and their observed command surfaces.

resources.name: Operator control state
resources.description: Goals, pause state, active runs and failures. Reading it neither resumes the operator nor authorizes work.

resources.name: Local model estate
resources.description: Live status of the managed local MoE owner. An unavailable status is explicit and never becomes a remote fallback claim.

resources.name: Project MCP runtime identity
resources.description: Running-versus-current Project MCP source-set identity and drift state for this process. Matching digests cover only the declared release source set.

resources.name: MCP capability toolsets
resources.description: Compact canonical MCP catalogue grouped by owner and read/effect class. Use mcp_capability_lens for an intent-filtered shortlist before loading full schemas.

resources.name: Estate capability control plane
resources.description: Coalesced local tools, models, generation profiles, adapters and provider fleet from the existing estate control plane. Discovery does not grant provider or effect authority.

resources.name: Project MCP product service profiles
resources.description: Candidate-only Project MCP product service profiles bound to a declared source-set digest. The catalogue includes local snapshot products and explicit continuation products; compilation is not deployment.

resources.name: Project MCP products
resources.description: Source-attested Project MCP product portfolio. Each product carries contract, toolset, release, deployment, listener, continuation and secret-free connection identities.

resources.name: Aurekai MCP operating contract
resources.description: How to use read, preparation and effect-bound tools without converting observations, budgets or quotes into authority.

resourceTemplates.name: Architecture entry
resourceTemplates.description: Read one canonical architecture entry by atlas identifier.

resourceTemplates.name: Matrix subject constellation
resourceTemplates.description: Read the configured native Matrix owner's lawful address coordinates for one subject. It never widens disclosure or authority.

resourceTemplates.name: MCP capability pack
resourceTemplates.description: Read one canonical Project MCP capability pack with its outcome, declared entry reads, primary effects and cross-aperture handoffs.

resourceTemplates.name: MCP capability pack snapshot
resourceTemplates.description: Read one canonical capability pack as a current server-owned snapshot of its context-free read owners. The snapshot remains a concurrent non-atomic projection and never grants the pack's primary effects.

resourceTemplates.name: Project MCP product manifest
resourceTemplates.description: Read one source-attested product connection and readiness manifest, including contract/toolset/release cache identities, deployment drift, listener identity and explicit cross-aperture handoffs, without constructing the full product portfolio.

prompts.name: institutional_circuit
prompts.title: Run an institutional circulation pass
prompts.description: Ground a proposed institution/market/physical-world circuit in Atlas, authority, evidence, finance and native execution owners before suggesting action.

arguments.name: subject
arguments.description: Stable subject or safe working identifier

prompts.name: evidence_bound_intake
prompts.title: Observe a foreign source without overclaiming
prompts.description: Use the lawful ForeignTwin intake path, then separate retained observation, candidate meaning, missing proof and any later authority boundary.

arguments.name: need
arguments.description: The exact evidence/capability gap being investigated

prompts.name: native_delivery_sprint
prompts.title: Turn a product gap into a native verified change
prompts.description: Use Atlas, source inspection, native capability owners and verification profiles to turn a product gap into a tested implementation rather than a demo/catalog surface.

arguments.name: outcome
arguments.description: Observable user outcome that must work

arguments.name: surface
arguments.description: Optional user-facing carrier, e.g. CMS, MCP, HTMX, API

prompts.name: addressed_participation
prompts.title: Resolve an addressed participation cut
prompts.description: Resolve a host/path through the native Matrix first, then separate the lawful address cut from still-required viewer, authority, provider, evidence and financial closures.

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.description: What the participant is trying to accomplish

prompts.name: product_pack_workflow
prompts.title: Operate a scoped Aurekai product pack
prompts.description: Run one canonical Project MCP product aperture from runtime/source truth through snapshot readiness, compact routing, selected schema expansion, explicit handoffs and authority-bounded effects.

arguments.name: pack
arguments.description: Canonical product pack: build, operate, model, commerce, connect, or account

arguments.name: objective
arguments.description: Concrete outcome to accomplish inside that product aperture
